nodes.label: A number-regex artefact confirmed by its own instability
nodes.rationale: The withdrawn-set list read [411, 1680, …], then [190, 411, 517, …], then [411, …] across three builds — gaining and losing members with no change in the volume's meaning, which is what identifies it as an artefact rather than a finding.
